mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.5%, it signals persistent inflationary pressures that prompt the Federal Reserve to maintain restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand and confidence, which drives corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days; the effect is multiplicative and not decomposable into individual series effects.
failure_condition: The joint effect of HOUST and RSAFS increases does not produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term's coefficient in a regression is not statistically significant (p>0.05) over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 7.5%), economic weakness dampens corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 7.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts (HOUST) indicates robust residential construction activity and consumer confidence, which typically precedes positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to improved economic outlook.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST increases, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 indicates weakening manufacturing activity, which signals potential economic slowdown and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a strong labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days; the effect is multiplicative and not decomposable into individual series effects.
failure_condition: The joint effect of PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases does not produce positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term's coefficient in a regression is not statistically significant (p>0.05) over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a high interest rate regime (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), higher borrowing costs suppress corporate investment and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
